questions.prompt: You hold Ah Kh on a flop of Qh 9c 4d. Your hand is…

choices.text: Overcards with the nut-flush draw: 9 flush outs, not 12.

questions.explanation: Two hearts on a one-heart board is a flush draw. Nine hearts remain. The two overcards are extra, not more flush outs.

questions.prompt: An open-ended straight draw has how many outs to the straight?
questions.explanation: Four cards on each end. A gutshot has 4. A flush draw has 9.

questions.prompt: From the flop, a rough equity for a 9-out flush draw through the river is…

choices.text: About 35%, using outs times 4. It is not a lock.
About 2%, using outs times 2 on the flop

questions.explanation: Outs times 4 is the flop-to-river shortcut. Outs times 2 is one card, which is the turn.

questions.prompt: Top pair with a weak kicker on a wet board is…

choices.text: A made hand that is often behind sets, two pair, and better kickers.
Air that should always stack off

questions.explanation: Classify the hand before you choose a size. One pair is not the nuts on a connected board.
